exposure: Implementation of French clinical guidelines (HAS/SFN) for the management of newborns over 34 weeks at risk of early-onset neonatal infection (EONI)
outcome: Extent of guideline implementation (full, partial, none)
Observed impact on additional tests (blood samples, peripheral bacteriological tests)
Continued practice of gastric fluid sample collection (despite non-recommendation)
Identified difficulties in implementation (lack of equipment, insufficient personnel, insufficient training time)
cohort: The participants were 78 maternity units in the Ile-de-France region that responded to a self-administered questionnaire about their application of French clinical guidelines.
finding: Three years after their publication, over 85% of responding maternity units in the Ile-de-France region reported implementing the French clinical guidelines for managing newborns at risk of EONI either fully or partially, with many observing a reduction in additional tests.
